levels.surface: محمد بن الحسن بن أحمد بن الوليد

notes: Rule 11: the saying is a first-person account («وَ بَعْدُ فَقَدْ حَضَرْنَا») by unnamed witnesses; the chain ends at the unnamed «من حضر موت الحسن»
«أبي» is the compiler's father, given only as a relation; «رضي الله عنهما» is a blessing, left out
Persons speaking inside the account (Ahmad ibn Ubayd Allah, the Caliph's officials) are in the scene, not links
